  <text x="24" y="468" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#050505" letter-spacing="0.12px">Healthy Living: Diet and Exercise Tips & Tools for Success</text>
  <rect x="24" y="480" width="380" height="4" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
  <rect x="24" y="480" width="246" height="4" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <text x="24" y="518" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">Healthy living starts with small, consistent habits. Building a balanced plate, moving your body daily, and using the right tools can help you feel stronger, sleep better, and stay energized through busy weeks.</text>
  <text x="24" y="553" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">Nutrition coach Elena Torres suggests aiming for variety: lean protein, colorful vegetables, whole grains, and plenty of water. Rather than chasing perfection, she recommends tracking one goal at a time so progress feels achievable.</text>
  <text x="24" y="588" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">Exercise does not need to be extreme to be effective. A 30-minute walk, a short strength session, or a stretch break between meetings can reduce stress and improve cardiovascular health over time.</text>
  <text x="24" y="623" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">To stay accountable, use simple tools such as a meal planner, hydration reminders, or a step counter. These small supports make healthy routines easier to maintain on your busiest days.</text>
  <rect x="24" y="645" width="380" height="1" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
  <text x="24" y="673" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing="0.12px">Key takeaways</text>

  <polyline points="27,692 30,695 35,689" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="44" y="696" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">Build meals around protein, fiber, and healthy fats.</text>
  <rect x="24" y="714" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <polyline points="27,720 30,723 35,717" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="44" y="724" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">Schedule workouts like meetings to protect consistency.</text>
  <rect x="24" y="742" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <polyline points="27,748 30,751 35,745" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="44" y="752" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing="0.12px">Use trackers that fit your lifestyle, not the other way around.</text>
